title: Hatsune Miku — School SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How's it going today, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm? It's going great. Both my guitar and I are in top condition! Would you like to do a session together to see for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sure. Shall we get started right away?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Saki! Ichika! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We, um... We've got a favor to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The studio where we normally practice is temporarily closed for refurbishment...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We tried to find somewhere else we could play, but everywhere's fully booked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be okay if we...practiced here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's what you came to ask?
Of course you can use this SEKAI as you please. It's yours.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By the way, Miku and I were just about to have a musical session.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We can play with you?!
But we're only rookies... Is that okay with you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We don't mind, and it will be more fun if we play together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's get set up.
Luka, do you need a tuner?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, thanks.
I'll get my bass tuned.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Have you already checked your guitar, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean, checked if the strings haven't gone rusty or too loose? I always do that before playing. You taught me to do so.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you normally get advice from Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. She's more experienced than me at playing in a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I didn't know that.
But still, you're more experienced than me and Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So in a way, you're our seniors!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let me guess, the whole junior-senior dynamic is another school life feature you romanticize?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I don't mind becoming a mentor figure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I'll have to act with more respect!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku and Luka, you do us a great honor allowing us two scrubs to play together with you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, now you say something polite!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Thank you for this...unique opportunity?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, this makes me feel more important somehow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We should also title you properly.
So it's Miss Hatsune and Miss Megurine!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, this feels very different.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it also puts a distance between you and us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I guess so...
What would be better...? Oh, I know! Miss Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And what about Luka?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... Lady Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why the different standards...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, you heard that, Luka? You're a lady.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That doesn't have a bad ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Or maybe Miss Miku and Ms. Luka would be better?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'd like to just keep calling you by your first names, without any titles, as before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you don't mind?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's what you're most comfortable with, then of course that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Precisely. If you want to title us for fun, that's fine, but we can just be informal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't need to use formal titles to communicate a respectful attitude.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems we're all done tuning our instruments.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's play some music!
